summary: Feed s103_single is degraded due to high encrypted traffic share (94.6% vs 90% NDR tolerance) limiting payload inspection. All other checks (duplicates, one-way, drops, overload, VLAN) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: 94.6% of bytes are encrypted (TLS/encrypted flows), exceeding the NDR's 90% tolerance. Traffic is delivered without broker-level decryption or selective forwarding from a decryption zone, so the NDR receives mostly opaque payloads.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for signature and behavioral detection; with ~95% encryption it is blind to most L7 content, reducing detection coverage for C2, exfiltration and lateral movement and increasing false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: NDR cannot analyze encrypted payloads natively. Decrypt relevant TLS at the packet broker/decryption zone or selectively forward decrypted traffic to the NDR, while respecting privacy/policy, to restore payload visibility within the 90% tolerance.
